story.text: 전포 카페거리, 커피를 기다리며 선우가 휴대폰 화면을 불쑥 내민다. "이거 봐라, 이거. 대박 아이가?"
story.reading: jeon-po ka-pe-geo-ri, keo-pi-reul gi-da-ri-myeo seon-u-ga hyu-dae-pon hwa-myeon-eul bul-ssuk nae-min-da. i-geo bwa-ra, i-geo. dae-bak a-i-ga?
story.en: In the Jeonpo cafe street, while waiting for coffee, Sunwoo suddenly holds out his phone screen. "Look at this, look. Isn't it insane?"

story.text: 화면 속 영상은 누가 봐도 우스꽝스러운 실수 모음이다. 나도 모르게 웃음이 터진다. "이거 완전 웃기다, 진짜."
story.reading: hwa-myeon sok yeong-sang-eun nu-ga bwa-do u-seu-kkwang-seu-reo-un sil-su mo-eum-i-da. na-do mo-reu-ge us-eum-i teo-jin-da. i-geo wan-jeon ut-gi-da, jin-jja.
story.en: The video on screen is clearly a compilation of ridiculous blunders. I can't help but burst out laughing. "This is completely hilarious, seriously."

story.text: "거 봐라, 요즘 애들 말로 '레전드'라 카는 기 이런 거다." 선우가 뿌듯한 표정으로 어깨를 으쓱인다.
story.reading: geo bwa-ra, yo-jeum ae-deul mal-lo le-jeon-deu-ra ka-neun gi i-reon geo-da. seon-u-ga ppu-deut-han pyo-jeong-eu-ro eo-kkae-reul eu-sseug-in-da.
story.en: "See, that's what kids these days call a 'legend' moment." Sunwoo shrugs, looking proud of himself.

story.text: "니 '인정?'이 뭔지는 아나? 누가 뭐라 카면, 그냥 '인정' 한마디만 하면 끝이다." 그가 손가락으로 오케이 표시를 만들며 설명한다.
story.reading: ni in-jeong-i mwon-ji-neun a-na? nu-ga mwo-ra ka-myeon, geu-nyang in-jeong han-ma-di-man ha-myeon kkeut-i-da. geu-ga son-ga-rak-eu-ro o-ke-i pyo-si-reul man-deul-myeo seol-myeong-han-da.
story.en: "Do you even know what 'in-jeong' means? Whenever someone says something, you just say 'agreed' and that's the end of it." He explains, making an okay sign with his fingers.

story.text: "이 노래 '띵곡'이다, 완전." 카페에서 흘러나오는 노래를 듣더니 그가 눈을 반짝인다. 나는 새로운 단어 하나를 배운 게 신기해서 자꾸 되뇐다.
story.reading: i no-rae tting-gok-i-da, wan-jeon. ka-pe-e-seo heul-leo-na-o-neun no-rae-reul deut-deo-ni geu-ga nun-eul ban-jjag-in-da. na-neun sae-ro-un dan-eo ha-na-reul bae-un ge sin-gi-hae-seo ja-kku doe-noe-in-da.
story.en: "This song is a total banger." His eyes light up as he listens to the song playing in the cafe. I keep repeating the new word to myself, fascinated to have learned it.

story.text: "근데 진짜, 니 부산말 배울 생각은 없나? '~하나', '~아이가' 이런 거." 그는 장난기 가득한 눈으로 나를 툭 찌른다.
story.reading: geun-de jin-jja, ni bu-san-mal bae-ul saeng-gak-eun eop-na? ha-na, a-i-ga i-reon geo. geu-neun jang-nan-gi ga-deuk-han nun-eu-ro na-reul tuk jji-reun-da.
story.en: "But seriously, don't you want to learn Busan dialect too? Things like '-hana', '-aiga'." He pokes me, eyes full of mischief.

story.text: "콜! 오늘부터 하나씩 가르쳐도." 나의 대답에 선우가 씩 웃는다. 커피 한 잔에 오늘의 유행어 수업이 시작됐다.
story.reading: kol! o-neul-bu-teo ha-na-ssik ga-reu-chyeo-do. na-ui dae-dab-e seon-u-ga ssik ut-neun-da. keo-pi han jan-e o-neul-ui yu-haeng-eo su-eob-i si-jak-dwaet-da.
story.en: "Deal! Teach me one at a time starting today." Sunwoo grins at my answer. Over a single cup of coffee, today's slang lesson had begun.

words.example_en: That match was an absolute legend.

words.meaning: agreed / I admit it (slang for acknowledging something)
a banger, a great song (slang, playful spelling of 명곡)
words.example_en: This song is a real banger.
I didn't know any of the current buzzwords.

sentences.en: That scene was a total legend.
I totally agree with what you said.
This song is famous as a banger these days.
I learned the latest buzzwords from a friend.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 이거 봐라, 이거. 대박 아이가? 완전 웃기제?
turns.reading: i-geo bwa-ra, i-geo. dae-bak a-i-ga? wan-jeon ut-gi-je?
turns.en: Look at this, look. Isn't it insane? Totally hilarious, right?

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 완전, 배꼽 빠지는 줄 알았어. 근데 대박이 무슨 뜻이야?
turns.reading: wan-jeon, bae-kkob ppa-ji-neun jul al-at-eo. geun-de dae-bak-i mu-seun tteus-i-ya?
turns.en: Totally, I nearly cracked a rib. But what does 'daebak' mean?

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 완전 놀랍다, 대단하다 그 뜻이다. 진짜 자주 쓰는 말이니까 외워도.
turns.reading: wan-jeon nol-lap-da, dae-dan-ha-da geu tteus-i-da. jin-jja ja-ju sseu-neun mal-i-ni-kka oe-wo-do.
turns.en: It means totally amazing, incredible. It's used all the time so memorize it.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 오케이, 대박! 이렇게 쓰면 되는 거지?
turns.reading: o-ke-i, dae-bak! i-reoh-ge sseu-myeon doe-neun geo-ji?
turns.en: Okay, daebak! Is this how I use it?

dialogues.question: 선우가 승객에게 '대박'이라는 표현에 대해 설명한 내용은 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: What did Sunwoo explain to the passenger about the expression 'daebak'?
dialogues.explanation: 선우는 '대박'이 정말 놀랍거나 대단할 때 쓰는 감탄 표현이라고 설명해줍니다.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 니 '인정?'이 뭔지는 아나? 누가 뭐라 카면 그냥 '인정' 한마디만 하면 끝이다.
turns.reading: ni in-jeong-i mwon-ji-neun a-na? nu-ga mwo-ra ka-myeon geu-nyang in-jeong han-ma-di-man ha-myeon kkeut-i-da.
turns.en: Do you know what 'in-jeong' means? Whenever someone says something, you just say 'agreed' and that's the end of it.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: Ah, so it means you agree?

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 정답이다. 예를 들어 '이 집 치킨 진짜 맛있제' 하면 '인정' 이렇게 쓴다.
turns.reading: jeong-dab-i-da. ye-reul deul-eo i jib chi-kin jin-jja mas-it-je ha-myeon in-jeong i-reoh-ge sseun-da.
turns.en: Exactly right. For example, if someone says 'this place's chicken is really good,' you'd reply 'agreed' like that.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 이해했어. 부산 사투리도 완전 인정이야, 너 덕분에.
turns.reading: i-hae-haet-eo. bu-san sa-tu-ri-do wan-jeon in-jeong-i-ya, neo deok-bun-e.
turns.en: Got it. Busan dialect gets my full approval too, thanks to you.

dialogues.question: 선우가 예시로 든 '인정'의 쓰임은 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: How did Sunwoo use '인정' in his example?
dialogues.correct_answer: 상대의 말에 동의를 표현할 때 쓴다
options: 상대의 말에 동의를 표현할 때 쓴다
dialogues.explanation: 선우는 '인정'이 상대방의 말에 동의할 때 쓰는 짧은 표현이라고 예를 들어 설명합니다.
